728-3558-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crookshank Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
728-3558-5006-8170.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crookshank Kobolds spell. Then, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat.

265-2073-5315--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact.
Sly Requisitioner triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the Servo.
When the Servo dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
265-2073-5315--90.notes: If the artifact can sacrifice itself, you can do so in lieu of sacrificing the artifact to Ravenous Intruder. Also, if the artifact can tap to produce mana (like Sol Ring) or other products, you can do that as well.

258-1409-2454-5696.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Jyoti.
258-1409-2454-5696.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
258-1409-2454-5696.description:
Activate Jyoti by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jyoti enters, it and Deadeye Navigator trigger.
Resolve the Jyoti trigger, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game
When the Forest Dryads enter, Tatyova triggers that many times, giving them haste until end of turn.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Jyoti.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

261-5900-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
261-5900-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

500-1308-2523-7824.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Bard and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Bard token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Bards dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Bard that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Bards you control plus one.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.

215-647-3151.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Elves.
215-647-3151.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Elvish Archdruid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Elvish Archdruid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-6627-7315.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to The Earth Crystal and High Score.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

4276-5088-5256-7443-7537.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
4276-5088-5256-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
4276-5088-5256-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Turnabout with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Turnabout from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Turnabout.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 18.

2793-3129-3743-5089-7435.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3129-3743-5089-7435.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

3490-4268-4659-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4268-4659-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2843-3175-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

4636-6871.notablePrerequisites: You are able to produce six {E} per turn.
4636-6871.description:
Produce six {E} by any method. This can include using Gonti's Aether Heart by having artifacts enter under your control.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, earthbending Gonti's Aether Heart.
Holding priority, activate Gonti's Aether Heart by paying eight {E} and exiling it.
Toph triggers, returning Gonti's Aether Heart from exile to the battlefield.
When Gonti's Aether Heart enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Resolve the Gonti's Aether Heart ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

338-3490-4659-6719.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2034-5220-5632-6753-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-5220-5632-6753-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating two creature tokens and two Clue tokens
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

104-4186-4321-6890.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-4186-4321-6890.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-5541-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-2079-2292.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Temur Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1558-4076-6753.notablePrerequisites:
You have a full party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1558-4076-6753.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker.
Burakos triggers, creating eight Treasure tokens and causing the defending player to lose 4 life.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4508-4875-5184-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

394-4798-5437-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
394-4798-5437-5686.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a 1/1 Bat creature token.
Repeat.

2034-2281-2757-5006.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one basic Forest.
You control at least one basic Plains.
2034-2281-2757-5006.description:
Activate a basic Forest and Plains by tapping them, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Earthcraft twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, untapping the basic Forest and Plains.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lurrus, adding {C}{C}.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

1270-3899-5231.notablePrerequisites: Spawning Pit has at least two charge counters on it.
1270-3899-5231.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating three 2/2 Spawn artifact creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Spawn, adding {R}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing two Spawns, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2178-3967-5470.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghired.
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
2178-3967-5470.description:
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the token dies, Ghired triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

967-1806-2034-2382-2604.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Mimic Vat triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard and returning any previously exiled creatures to their owners' graveyards.
Cast Eternal Scourge for {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Eternal Scourge, allowing it to enter the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2607-3485.description:
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, Havoc Festival triggers, causing them to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of their end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent whose turn it is loses the game due to having zero or less life.
Repeat during each other opponent's turn.
